ArtifactRef.description:
Immutable dependency identity with canonical-content or raw-byte SHA-256.

The artifact kind defines the hashing convention; model artifacts use
identity.py canonical JSON, while preserved source files use raw bytes.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

CoverageSummary.description:
Declared scope of a release, for the root discovery page.

`scope` and `out_of_scope` repeat the release's sealed scope statement per
language and are empty when the release publishes none. Everything else is
computed from the catalog, the coverage profiles, the language policy and
the citations, so the two parts can be told apart: the curator wrote the
first, the server derived the second.
CoverageSummary.title: CoverageSummary

DateRange.description:
Applicability window with open bounds by default.

Knowledge carries no commencement or expiry date unless its cited source
states one (a treaty applied from a fixed date, a law in force from a
future date). A missing bound is unbounded. Snapshot age is a separate
freshness concern recorded on each citation.
DateRange.title: DateRange

EvidenceEquivalence.description:
Review attests interchangeable claim support for these exact revisions.

Concept alignment alone cannot create this artifact. All members support
each listed fact with the same conditions; omitted/partial translations
belong outside the group.
EvidenceEquivalence.title: EvidenceEquivalence

JurisdictionCoverage.description: Places served at one level for one intent, each with the same number of concepts.
JurisdictionCoverage.title: JurisdictionCoverage

PublishedRule.description: All-of scalar predicates selecting pre-authored facts, never executable code.
PublishedRule.title: PublishedRule

ResolutionPortion.description: One required, reviewed portion of an operation's finite coverage.
ResolutionPortion.title: ResolutionPortion

ScopeStatement.description:
Declared scope of a release, sealed with its catalog.

Served verbatim in the root coverage summary so that a caller can decline
a question outside the served coverage after one call. The curator writes
it next to the concepts; the builder records its provenance.
ScopeStatement.title: ScopeStatement

ScopeText.description: A curated statement of what a release covers and does not cover, in one language.
ScopeText.title: ScopeText

TopicSummary.description: One resolvable topic of a release, for the root coverage summary.
TopicSummary.title: TopicSummary
